title: DRE-LZSH: SEEG benchmark dataset for drug-resistant epilepsy (ictal and interictal segments, 29 patients)
description: This dataset provides stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from 29 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, comprising ictal (seizure) and interictal segments sampled at 2000 Hz. It includes clinical information and channel-level epileptogenic-zone annotations, and is intended as a benchmark for precision-medicine research in epilepsy. The data are re-packaged in iEEG-BIDS from the authors' Zenodo release, together with the authors' derived HFO-rate and power-spectrum result tables and analysis code.
methods_description: SEEG segments were recorded at 2000 Hz. Seizure segments typically last 40-60 s, and interictal segments are longer. MATLAB arrays from the original release were losslessly converted to BrainVision float32 files with BIDS sidecars, without filtering, resampling, re-referencing or channel removal. Channel types were inferred from channel names. The release provides no electrode coordinates.
